title: Supported Versions & OS Compatibility for Microsegmentation

blocks.text: Before configuring Microsegmentation policies, you must configure and deploy agents to your physical or virtual machine (VM) based on your operating system (OS).
To learn more, see About Agents, Configuring Agent Groups, and Installing & Upgrading the Agent Manager.
Microsegmentation only supports the x86_64 CPU architecture, not ARM64.
Each OS requires a specific compatible version to configure Microsegmentation. Additionally, a minimum required agent version is listed for the OS, if applicable.

table: RHEL 7.9 (A minimum kernel version of 3.10.0-1160.160.1.el7.x86_64 is required.) RHEL 8 RHEL 9 RHEL 10
